name: ccvl-cv
title_zh: 改一行经历，六个页面同步重排的简历排版工
tagline_zh: Summary、项目、技能、关键词或页预设一变，所有简历变体自动重排并校验。不用再手动同步五份文档。
tagline_en: Change one field—summary, projects, skills, keywords, or page preset—and every CV variant re-renders and.
desc_en: Write, tailor, render, and verify ccvl CV variants when Summary, experience, projects, competencies, keywords, or page presets change.
why_zh: 把简历当代码管：单一数据源驱动多套版式，渲染后自动跑校验，改完就知道哪页溢出了。
why_en: Treats CVs as code: one source drives multiple layouts, with post-render checks that catch overflow before you export—not after.
limit_zh: 只认 ccvl 项目自己的 YAML 数据结构和预设页模板；不解析 Word/PDF 已有简历，也不生成图片或打印稿。
limit_en: Only handles ccvl's own YAML schema and page presets; won't parse existing Word/PDF CVs or output images. Produces ccvl sources and previews only.
title_en: Resume layout engine that re-renders all variants from one.
